snippet.title: [Bober Bros] Last Pill Bar - Announcement Trailer | Psychological Horror Bartender Sim
snippet.description:
Wishlist Last Pill Bar on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4603670/Bober_Bros_Last_Pill_Bar/

Last Pill Bar is a choice-driven psychological horror bartender sim where you serve drinks, meet troubled regulars, play pub games, and shape their stories through branching dialogue.

It starts cute.
Then it gets heavy.

ABOUT THE GAME
- Run the bar for the night.
- Serve drinks and manage regulars with their own moods, habits, and problems.
- Talk with troubled guests and decide who you want to help.
- Play pub games and after-hours drinking competitions.
- Make choices that change character stories and endings.
- Short, replayable runs with a darker psychological layer underneath the surface.

Content note:
Contains psychological horror, alcoholism-related themes, disturbing material, and heavy emotional content. Not for children or the easily disturbed.
